correctness.rationale: The pivot-score identities are directly reconstructed from the source Algorithm 2 in a tournament. Exact C99 loops over all 2^(n(n-1)/2) bit masks at n=2..7 give counts (0,0,0,0,0,5040), and zero disjoint winners at all sizes. Independent Boolean Python recomputes witness scores and all 7! relabelings, yielding orbit size 5040. Equivariance and equality with total count prove the unique orbit. The claim is finite and does not extrapolate beyond n=7.
